description: Unique identifier for one customer shopping session
Identifier for the customer who owns the session (customers can have multiple sessions)
Calendar date the session occurred
Day name derived from session_date
Hour of day the session started (0-23)
Marketing season/period bucket derived from the month
Customer age in years
Self-reported gender
Household income bracket
City classification tier (1 = largest metros)
Device used for this session
Marketing channel that originally acquired the customer
Behavioral segment based on historical order count (New/Occasional/Regular/Loyal)
Number of orders placed by this customer prior to the observation window
Days since the customer's previous order (missing for New customers)
Total session duration in minutes
Number of pages viewed in the session
Number of distinct products viewed in the session
Number of on-site searches performed
Whether the session included at least one add-to-cart event
Number of items added to cart (0 if add_to_cart is False)
Whether an item was added to the wishlist
Whether the customer was exposed to a discount during the session
Discount percentage exposed (0 if not discount_exposed)
Whether free shipping was offered
Whether the session was exposed to a marketing campaign
Type of campaign exposed (None if not campaign_exposed)
Type of promotional offer exposed (None if not campaign_exposed)
Monetary value of the offer in INR (0 if not campaign_exposed)
Estimated delivery time quoted to the customer
Additional days beyond the estimate the order was delayed (0 if on time)
Customer's average historical rating given to past orders
Payment method used or selected
Product category browsed/purchased
Price tier of the item(s) viewed (Budget/Value/Premium/Luxury)
Number of items purchased in the session (0 if purchase is False)
Whether the session resulted in a completed purchase (the central outcome variable)
Total order value in INR (0 if purchase is False)
Whether the order was later returned (only possible if purchase is True)
Days after purchase the return was initiated (0 if not returned)
Post-purchase satisfaction rating 1-5 (null if not purchased)
Profit margin percentage on the order (null if not purchased)
Whether the customer is not a first-time (New) customer
Session flagged as high purchase-intent (top-quartile products viewed + add-to-cart + above-median duration)
0-100 composite score blending duration/pages/products/searches/cart activity (min-max weighted blend)
0-1 score indicating how reliant the session's behavior was on discount exposure
Whether a cart was converted to a purchase (null if add_to_cart is False, otherwise same as purchase)
Sum of order_value across all of this customer's sessions in the dataset
customer_total_spend divided by the customer's number of purchases in the dataset
Share of this customer's purchases in the dataset that were returned
Value tier from customer_total_spend quartiles (High/Mid/Low Value/No Purchase Yet)
Alias of days_since_last_order used in waiting-time analyses
Simulated days until the customer's next purchase (exponential draw parameterized by segment rate; modeling illustration -- not an observed outcome)
